description: Calculates single-turn throughput and cost efficiency from scalar promptLength, responseLength, and latencyMs (>= 1), returning characterPerMs, cognitiveEfficiencyScore (0.1–1.0), dragRating (HIGH above 2500ms), and estimatedTokenCostRating (EXPENSIVE above 4000 combined chars). Free, deterministic, stateless local math with no API key required. Use for quick single-turn latency/length math; use systemores_analyze_trace_telemetry for multi-span OpenTelemetry JSON traces or systemores_evaluate_drift for multi-turn behavioral consistency.

latencyMs.description: The end-to-end response latency in milliseconds. Must be >= 1.

promptLength.description: The character length of the prompt sent to the agent.

responseLength.description: The character length of the agent's response.

name: systemores_measure_drag
title: Measure Cognitive Throughput Drag
